subject: CareBridge: feature-level economics & CAC payback — follow-up and worksheets
messages:
From: Ella Johnson <ella@carebridge.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@carebridge.com>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo follow-up: feature econ + CAC expectations

Thanks for the demo this afternoon — good to meet the product team. A quick recap from our side and a few asks so we can scope internally: 

Summary/high-level asks
- We're evaluating a multi-feature launch (SmartSummaries + Patient Triage + Message Drafting). Need a per-feature unit econ that we can plug into our pricing model.
- Primary constraint: finance wants CAC payback <= 12 months for new users acquired via the PLG funnel.
- Target margin on feature revenue (after inference) should be >= 55% initially.

Initial budget context
- Monthly budget range we can allocate to inference during pilot: $8k — $28k (flexible by month)
- Expected token mix (very rough): SmartSummaries ~40% of calls, Triage ~35%, Drafting ~25%
- Estimated calls/day during pilot: 8k — 25k (we'll confirm MAU => DAU conversion)

Requests for Redwood (next steps)
1) Can you provide a short workbook with: per-feature tokens/call assumptions, $/1M tokens pricing scenarios (retail and cost), projected inference cost per feature, and resulting contribution margin and months-to-payback given our CAC estimate of $120.
2) Any quantization/throughput options that change unit cost assumptions (and expected % savings by model/format).
3) A short recommended pilot sizing (tokens/month buckets) that aligns with our $8k-$28k budget so we can choose a pilot path.

Attachments: we will share a small CSV with our current DAU/MAU mix — attaching separately.

Thanks — Ella

Ella Johnson
Head of Product
CareBridge
ella@carebridge.com
+1 (415) 555-0198
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Ella Johnson <ella@carebridge.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 17:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo follow-up: feature econ + CAC expectations

Ella — really appreciate the clear asks and the budget band. Quick recap and what we'll deliver by EOD Wednesday (attached workbook + two pricing scenarios):

What we'll include
- Per-feature assumptions (tokens/call median + p95), three pilot token buckets (Low/Med/High) aligned to your $8k-$28k budget, and a sensitivity table for $/1M tokens.
- Two recommended retail pricing lanes: Conservative (aims for 55% margin) and Growth (lower per-token price to accelerate adoption, longer payback).
- Notes on quantization: preliminary estimates for int4/int8 cost reductions and latency tradeoffs.

Prelim numbers (very high level, to set expectations)
- Redwood estimated compute cost (base, pre-discount) for the model family we demoed: ~$720 / 1M tokens (this reflects GPU-hours, ops, and KV-cache overhead at pilot scale).
- Suggested retail pricing for pilot: $2,000 — $2,500 / 1M tokens (gives ~60% gross margin vs compute cost, before CAC/op ex).
- Example per-feature (using median tokens/call)
  * SmartSummaries: 150 tokens/call median. 10k calls/day -> ~45M tokens/month -> inference bill at $2,200/1M ~= $99k/month. (This is illustrative; pilot will be smaller.)
  * Patient Triage: 350 tokens/call median. 3k calls/day -> ~31.5M tokens/month -> ~$69.3k/month at $2,200/1M.
  * Message Drafting: 800 tokens/call median. 1k calls/day -> ~24M tokens/month -> ~$52.8k/month at $2,200/1M.

Why these lanes
- The $/1M ranges balance our unit-cost estimate with a conservative margin target to keep per-feature contribution positive while allowing room for CAC recovery.

Deliverables and asks from you
- CSV with expected DAU/MAU and rough per-feature adoption splits (you mentioned you'll attach).
- Confirmation of acceptable latency budget per feature (we'll size model variant and quantization accordingly).

Attaching: carebridge_econ_workbook_v1.xlsx (contains Low/Med/High pilot buckets, sensitivity tables, and a blank payback sheet). Ben and Grace — looping you in to validate compute-cost assumptions and quantization uplift.

Next steps: I'll follow up with an internal note summarizing the different payback scenarios (months to recover $120 CAC) once we have your usage CSV.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Ella Johnson <ella@carebridge.com>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo follow-up: feature econ + CAC expectations

Karthik / Ella — quick technical note to refine the workbook numbers before we send final: 
- If CareBridge is comfortable with int4 quantized weights + our KV-cache modes, we typically see ~22–30% reduction in per-token compute cost at pilot scale (depending on sequence length). Update to compute-cost estimate: base ~$720/1M -> quantized path ~$560/1M.
- For long-sequence features like Message Drafting, the savings are slightly lower (approx 18%) due to higher KV-cache retention and memory bandwidth.

I'll update carebridge_econ_workbook_v1.xlsx (tab: compute_assumptions) and reattach. Also adding a payoff sheet that calculates months-to-payback for the $120 CAC across different retail price points.

Ben
Ben Carter
Head of Pricing Analytics — Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
From: Ella Johnson <ella@carebridge.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@carebridge.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 5 May 2027 09:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo follow-up: feature econ + CAC expectations

Thanks — this is great context and the workbook looks useful. Quick confirmations and next steps from our side: 
- We'll upload the DAU/MAU CSV to the Drive link you provided by EOD Wednesday.
- Latency targets: SmartSummaries and Triage need P95 < 700ms; Drafting can tolerate up to P95 1.5s.
- We're inclined to try the quantized path if Redwood can commit to the 22–25% savings estimate and provide an SLA note for latency impact at pilot scale.

Action items
1) CareBridge: upload CSV with adoption splits and confirm pilot month (we're aiming for June).
2) Redwood: finalize workbook with quantized compute column and months-to-payback table (Ben to confirm updated numbers).
3) Both: quick 30-min call next week to agree on pilot bucket (low|med|high) and roll plan.

Appreciate the fast turnaround — Ella

--
Ella Johnson
Head of Product, CareBridge
